summary: The solution demonstrates strong feature engineering and a solid ensembling approach, but is fundamentally undermined by multiple forms of data leakage. It improperly computes imputation statistics, frequency encodings, and out-of-fold target encodings in ways that leak test or validation information into the training set. Additionally, fitting TF-IDF and SVD globally before cross-validation compromises the integrity of the out-of-fold evaluation.
